release_name: XRayMesh v2.2.6-beta.5 (Peers Redesign, One-Click Updates & Beta Channel)
changelog: Redesigned Peers & Nodes with a clean server list and a This server card. Any server can now be updated with one click from any panel: files are verified before install, the previous version is restored automatically if the update is unhealthy, and progress is shown live. Each server can opt into beta updates from any panel.
